story.reading: sol-jik-hi mal-hae-bwa-ra. ni nae-han-te ma-eum it-je?
story.en: Tell me honestly. You have feelings for me, don't you?

story.text: 내는 이제 '확신한다', 이게 그냥 소꿉친구 감정이 아니라는 거.
story.reading: nae-neun i-je hwak-sin-han-da, i-ge geu-nyang so-kkup-chin-gu gam-jeong-i a-ni-ra-neun geo.
story.en: I'm certain now, that this isn't just childhood-friend feelings.

story.text: 와 대답 안 하고 자꾸 '얼버무리노'. 내도 지금 말 자꾸 헛나온다, 니만 그런 거 아이다.
story.reading: wa dae-dap an ha-go ja-kku eol-beo-mu-ri-no. nae-do ji-geum mal ja-kku heon-na-on-da, ni-man geu-reon geo a-i-da.
story.en: Why do you keep mumbling and avoiding the answer instead of just replying. I'm stumbling over my words too right now, it's not just you.

story.text: 오늘은 '용기' 내가꼬 확실히 물어볼란다. 몇 번을 삼켰는지 모른다, 이 말.
story.reading: o-neul-eun yong-gi nae-ga-kko hwak-sil-hi mul-eo-bol-lan-da. myeot beon-eul sam-kyeon-neun-ji mo-reun-da, i mal.
story.en: Today I'm gathering my courage to ask you clearly. I don't know how many times I've swallowed this question back down.

story.text: 돌려 말 안 하고 그냥 '직진할게'. 니 내 좋아하나?
story.reading: dol-lyeo mal an ha-go geu-nyang jik-jin-hal-ge. ni nae jo-a-ha-na?
story.en: I won't beat around the bush, I'll just go straight for it. Do you like me?

story.text: 태종대 파도 소리 들리제? 대답 들을 때까지 안 움직인다, 내.
story.reading: tae-jong-dae pa-do so-ri deul-li-je? dae-dap deul-eul ttae-kka-ji an um-jik-in-da, nae.
story.en: You can hear the waves at Taejongdae, right? I'm not moving until I hear your answer.

story.text: 단어 다 봤제? 오늘 대화 문제도 집중해서 풀어봐라.
story.reading: dan-eo da bwat-je? o-neul dae-hwa mun-je-do jip-jung-hae-seo pul-eo-bwa-ra.
story.en: Got a look at all the words? Focus and give today's conversation question a try too.

words.example_en: Honestly speaking, I'm not sure either.
I was certain of his sincerity.

words.meaning: To mumble, evade giving a clear answer
words.example_en: He mumbled and avoided answering the question.

words.meaning: To go straight for it, be direct
words.example_en: He's the type to go straight for it without hesitation.

sentences.en: Honestly speaking, I don't really know either.
I was certain that he was sincere.
He didn't answer the question and just mumbled.
I mustered courage and conveyed my feelings.
He's the type of person who goes straight for it without hesitation.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 니 내 좋아하나? 오늘은 얼버무리지 말고 대답해라.
turns.reading: ni nae jo-a-ha-na? o-neul-eun eol-beo-mu-ri-ji mal-go dae-dap-hae-ra.
turns.en: Do you like me? Don't mumble around it today, just answer.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 가, 갑자기 그런 걸 왜 묻노...
turns.reading: ga, gap-ja-gi geu-reon geol wae mut-no...
turns.en: W-why are you suddenly asking that...

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 됐다, 대답 피하지 마라. 나는 진지하다. …손 봐라, 아직도 떨고 있다 내가.
turns.reading: dwaet-da, dae-dap pi-ha-ji ma-ra. na-neun jin-ji-ha-da. …son bwa-ra, a-jik-do tteol-go it-da nae-ga.
turns.en: Come on, don't avoid the answer. I'm serious. …Look at my hand, I'm still shaking.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: ...That's right. I like you, and have for a long time.

dialogues.question: 이 대화의 결과로 알 수 있는 것은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What can be concluded from the outcome of this conversation?
dialogues.correct_answer: 승객이 선우에 대한 자신의 마음을 솔직하게 인정했다
options: 승객이 선우에 대한 자신의 마음을 솔직하게 인정했다
dialogues.explanation: 승객은 처음엔 당황하지만 결국 선우를 오래전부터 좋아해 왔다고 솔직하게 인정합니다.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Not a joke. What about you? How do you feel.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 내가 먼저 물어봤는데 이래 되뿌네. 하... 내도 마찬가지다. 이 말 하는데 얼굴이 와 이래 뜨겁노.
turns.reading: nae-ga meon-jeo mul-eo-bwat-neun-de i-rae doe-ppu-ne. ha... nae-do ma-chan-ga-ji-da. i mal ha-neun-de eol-gul-i wa i-rae tteu-geop-no.
turns.en: I was the one who asked first, and now this happens. Ha... I feel the same way. Why's my face this hot just saying that.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 그럼 우리 이제 뭐가 되는 거고?
turns.reading: geu-reom u-ri i-je mwo-ga doe-neun geo-go?
turns.en: So what are we now, then?

dialogues.question: 선우의 반응에서 알 수 있는 그의 마음은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What does Sunwoo's reaction reveal about his feelings?
dialogues.correct_answer: 승객과 같은 마음이라는 것을 인정하며 기뻐하는 마음
options: 승객과 같은 마음이라는 것을 인정하며 기뻐하는 마음
예상치 못한 대답에 화가 난 마음
빨리 이 상황을 피하고 싶은 마음
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 놀란 듯하면서도 자신도 같은 마음이라고 인정하며, 서로의 진심이 확인되는 순간입니다.
